meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页打磨得更美观、更规范,同时兼顾性能与无障碍。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常做前端界面调整,却不太确定设计是否好看。
copy.tagline_en: Polish web pages to be more elegant, consistent, and accessible.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often tweak frontend interfaces but are unsure about design taste.

howto.what: 处理前端相关的建站、改样式、组件、React 项目等请求:先确定设计参考与设计规范文件(DESIGN.md),再做设计研究、用真实浏览器跑性能与无障碍审计,最后检查视觉效果。
howto.when: 当请求涉及前端/UI/UX、页面重设计、React 或性能检查等工作,或提到“像某品牌”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个落地页按 Stripe 风格重做,并先出 DESIGN.md。
say.note: 会先建设计规范,再依规范改页面。

say.text: 先做设计研究,再生成两三个概念稿给我选。
say.note: 会并行查参考库和真实产品截图。

howto.what_en: For frontend tasks, it first routes to a design reference set, requires a DESIGN.md contract before writing code, runs design research, audits performance and accessibility in a real browser, and visually critiques the result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for frontend/UI/UX work, a redesign, React or performance checks, or mention prompts like 'like X brand' or 'make it pretty'.

say_en.text: Redo this landing page in Stripe's style and write DESIGN.md first.
say_en.note: Sets up the design contract before UI changes.

say_en.text: Audit this React app for performance; Lighthouse 100 on mobile and desktop.
say_en.note: Runs real-browser audits multiple times and takes the median.

say_en.text: Do design research first, then show me 2-3 concept drafts.
say_en.note: Pulls brand refs and real screens in parallel.
